Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (12)
Nearly thirty Genesis Knights were on board the fleet that Rondo had led and appeared with.
Clearly, it was a reckless move.
From the Demon Army' perspective, there was no reason to send out so many Genesis Knights without knowing that the operation of the Plutonian Cannon had completely ceased.

Moreover, the coalition's Genesis Knights were now in the middle of getting noticeably tired. It was clearly a more rational judgment to stick to the existing strategy, wait for the coalition's Genesis Knights to get more tired, and continue to shake the central battlefield with the remaining troops.

However, Rondo, even knowing that fact, and even knowing that Jin would surely use the Plutonian Cannon, had stepped onto the battlefield. Even going as far as to annihilate one completed Origin Stone from another dimension to temporarily alleviate the restrictions of interdimensional interference.

“You have made us think too much, Jin Runcandel. I kept making bad moves, being played by that. But it was a simple problem. In the end, everyone is bound to be equal before a truly great power. Lord Kelliark is not in this place, but for now, your flying fortress can play that role, I suppose.”
After the battle began, Rondo and the Demon Army were shocked at every moment by the coalition's underlying strength.

Among all, the most shocking was, by far, the Plutonian Cannon. It was what had made the Demon Army flinch the most, even more than the martial prowess of Chiron or Van, who had overwhelmed the other Genesis Knights.
“As you said, we are nothing but soldiers without conviction or pride. But because of that, we can cross the line even more unreservedly.”
Laprarosa was ascending, aiming at the fierce battlefield of the Genesis Knights. Rondo smirked as he looked at Laprarosa, which had risen like the sun.
“You must be prepared to massacre all of them, both friend and foe, right? Madness is not your exclusive property, Jin Runcandel... Come!”
Zzzzzzzzzzt...!
Vast sun energy was gathering at the cannon barrel of Laprarosa that had emerged from the hull. Kwal broke out in a cold sweat as he looked at the various figures appearing on the power screen.

“This is crazy, you really want me to fire... this? The power is rising to an absurd level. Those bastards just used a large number of dimensional gates, causing Malugia's power and Beltian to resonate even more. If we fire like this, our allied Genesis Knights could really all die!”
It was a figure that not even Qwaul, who had personally developed the Plutonian Cannon, had ever imagined.
“Baba! Tell the leader to reconsider just once. This is no different from telling us to kill all our allied Genesis Knights!”
At those words, Baba shook his head with a heavy face. Not only from Jin, but also from Van, no communication to reverse the decision was coming in.
“...Dozens of Genesis Knights have come out. There is no other way but this, Qwaul. Focus on maintenance, it doesn't seem like it will end with just one shot.”

When they had first fired the Plutonian Cannon, the coalition's Genesis Knights had gathered in one place and formed a shield. However, since they were now in a position to be hit directly, it seemed better to scatter as much as possible and use the enemy Genesis Knights.
Jin had naturally thought that his allied Genesis Knights would have made the same judgment. But instead of scattering, the Genesis Knights were showing a movement of gathering around Jin.
“Everyone, protect the youngest somehow.”
“Father?”
“Deciding to use the Plutonian Cannon was an excellent judgment. But if by any chance you were to die, what would we do about the arrangement? Even if everyone else dies, you alone must survive.”
The Genesis Knights, excluding Jin, nodded at Chiron's words.
Jin was about to refute but closed his mouth. It was already too late to scatter again, and in truth, it was the right thing to say.
“You need to focus, so don't you dare throw a tantrum saying you shouldn't, Brother Jin.”
“...No, I will be protected quietly.”
“You should.”
Kwaaaaaaaaaa-!

The moment Van answered, the Plutonian Cannon fell on the fierce battlefield. The golden tsunami, fired at an angle, was first seen melting all the enemies who had set up camp near the battlefield with just its heat alone.
A bombardment falling as fast as light; however, even before the cannonball reached, blood burst from the eyes, ears, and mouths of the allied Genesis Knights.
“Keuk...!”
“Kaaaaaah!”
Only one person, Jin, who was surrounded by the Genesis Knights, did not spill blood. The shock that should have gone to him was being shared by all the other Genesis Knights.
Jin gritted his teeth as he stared at the backs of Chiron and Van.

Due to the golden tsunami created by the Plutonian Cannon, the figures of the enemies did not enter his vision. However, in the great flow of power, he could make out the general movement of the enemy Genesis Knights.

“Youngest, you read the enemies' movements. We do not have the leeway as we are protecting you. And give commands whenever necessary. We must catch as many enemies as possible before the Plutonian Cannon ends.”
“There's no law saying more enemy Genesis Knights won't be added after this. But it seems certain that those bastards have thrown their decisive move.”
Only two of the Genesis Knights protecting Jin, Chiron and Van, were speaking.
Because it was a feat that was only possible for them. That was the same even including all the Genesis Knights of the Demon Army, not just the coalition's Genesis Knights.
Use that advantage.
That was what Chiron was saying to Jin. To unilaterally strike the enemies in this golden hell using himself and Van, even while withstanding the Plutonian Cannon.
Not a single enemy Genesis Knight had died yet. They were quietly withstanding the Plutonian Cannon, centered on Rondo, with their shields deployed.

'As expected, among those bastards, there is no one who can perform other activities within the Plutonian Cannon like Father or Brother Van. If I choose the path well, as Father said, only we can cut them down.'

The completely defenseless enemy Genesis Knights could be finished off without even unfolding a great sword technique like a decisive move or an ultimate technique. If only they could break through the Plutonian Cannon and reach them.
He had to see the path well. He had to break through the bleak and densely spread golden tsunami and approach the enemies.
The Plutonian Cannon was churning chaotically, like a storm. In other words, the path that Jin could choose was changing at every moment.
Jin, who had been observing the golden tsunami, suddenly looked at Chiron's back once more.
It was as if he could see his father's past. Against the Black Sea, whose terrain changed every day, he had eventually seized victory at the end of a lifelong battle.
'For me to find a path in here today is not a very difficult task compared to my father completing the destiny of the Black Sea... Concentrate. I can find it.'
If he were to take even one step wrong, he didn't know what might happen. Chiron's right arm could suddenly be torn off, or Luna could meet her death.
“Father, Brother Van. To what distance can you attack?”
“Three hundred paces.”
“Three hundred paces.”
The two answered at the same time. If so, the number of steps the Genesis Knights had to advance was about a hundred. While taking a hundred steps, they could not fail even once.
Jin caught his breath and calmly looked at the light of the Plutonian Cannon.
“From now on, everyone, please move according to my steps and stride. For now, I will advance one step.”
As Jin took a step, the Genesis Knights began to advance in sync with him.
“We must move two steps to the left and then advance again. No, just advance as you are again...”
While walking twenty steps.
Jin did not make a single mistake. He had perfectly read the endlessly changing flow of the Plutonian Cannon.
However, it wasn't that there were no problems.
'...The speed is too slow. At this rate, the possibility of the Plutonian Cannon ending before we enter Father and Brother Van's attack range is too great.'

If that were to happen, the moment the influence of the Plutonian Cannon disappeared, the coalition's Genesis Knights would rather be in danger. Because a single Plutonian Cannon shot could not kill more than three enemy Genesis Knights, so they would be immediately attacked by the rest.

Of course, if they were to fire the second Plutonian Cannon right away, the same situation would repeat, but the problem was the brief gap before the second shot followed. The coalition's Genesis Knights would have to withstand the attack of over twenty Genesis Knights in a battered state.
'I have to throw a decisive move, even if it means taking a risk. I have to move faster. Even if the path is not certain.'
The moment he thought that far and was about to take a step, Jin suddenly flinched and looked ahead. Still the backs of Chiron and Van, but a familiar blue window was rising up in front of them.
'...Valeria!?'
It was a record window.
Valeria was, of course, included in the reinforcements that Silkia and Focal had brought. However, Jin had deliberately not called Valeria to the fierce battlefield of the Genesis Knights.

Firstly, she could not withstand this battle. The minimum standard to withstand the fierce battlefield could be said to be a Genesis Knight. Therefore, Valeria could not have shown a record in this way in the first place.
Secondly, she had to analyze the records of the entire battlefield. Because she had to grasp the scale of the enemy forces.

Lastly, it was the judgment that no matter how great recording magic was, it was impossible to analyze the 'flow' of the Plutonian Cannon in real time. The flow was bound to change faster in real time than it could be described in the record window.
But the record window that had appeared before his eyes now was showing Jin the way.
<Advance seven steps and then stop until the third wave ends.>
A spoken-style narration that had only ever appeared once on Valeria's record window until now. The moment Jin saw that sentence, he recalled wha
t Valeria had said not long ago.
-<Your Jin Runcandel has succeeded.>, this is probably a record that the me from another world left for the me of this world.
'The Valeria from another world is helping us, the one who left the message back then...!'
It could not be an enemy trap.
Valeria's magic, that unique flow—Jin knew it better than anyone in the world. Without a doubt, this was surely Valeria's magic. Even if it was the Valeria from another world.
“Another reinforcement has arrived. We will advance seven steps. Father, before the Plutonian Cannon ends, your two swords can reach those bastards!”
The record window was continuously being updated.
Jin was able to approach the enemies several times faster than when he was reading the path on his own.
